person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: re-epithelialization and immune cell behaviour in an ex vivo human skin wound made by suction
span.quote: Here, we present a novel wound model based on application of negative pressure and its effects for epidermal regeneration and immune cell behaviour.

span.label: whether a human ex vivo wound can be made without disrupting the dermal compartment
span.quote: A large body of literature is available on wound healing in humans. nonetheless, a standardized ex vivo wound model without disruption of the dermal compartment has not been put forward with compelling justification.

span.label: a suction-blister wound model in which the basement membrane survives and the wound bed starts free of keratinocytes
span.quote: Importantly, the basement membrane remained intact after blister roof removal and keratinocytes were absent in the wounded area.

span.label: method
span.quote: To our knowledge, we have efficaciously applied for the first time negative pressure (suction) to ex vivo human skin leading to the formation of typical blisters.

span.label: closure of an epidermal wound by keratinocyte migration and proliferation from the wound edges
span.quote: Importantly, the basement membrane remained intact after blister roof removal and keratinocytes were absent in the wounded area.

span.label: negative pressure applied to ex vivo human skin, blister roof removed, cultured at an air-liquid interphase
span.term: negative pressure applied to ex vivo human skin, blister roof removed, cultured at an air-liquid interphase
span.quote: Here, we present a novel wound model based on application of negative pressure and its effects for epidermal regeneration and immune cell behaviour.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: EACH SEPARATION METHOD DAMAGES A DIFFERENT THING, WHICH IS WHY NONE IS GENERAL: heat harms epidermis and dermis, chemicals disturb the electrolyte equilibrium, enzymes kill components - and mechanical force is chosen because it changes nothing chemically
span.quote: Simplicity of separation by inducing heat is accompanied by its damaging influence on both epidermis and dermis12. Chemical reagents disturb the electrolyte cellular equilibrium, or in case of enzymes, kill important components13,14.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: THE MODEL'S WHOLE POINT IS WHAT IT LEAVES INTACT: the basement membrane survives blister roof removal and no keratinocytes remain in the wound bed, so closure afterwards must come from the edges
span.quote: Importantly, the basement membrane remained intact after blister roof removal and keratinocytes were absent in the wounded area.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: EX VIVO IS SLOWER THAN IN VIVO AND THE PAPER SAYS WHY: culture lacks factors that arriving cells from the circulation would supply, and the dermal cells have been removed
span.quote: This was somewhat delayed compared to in vivo experiments41 and may be due to a deficiency of factors under culture conditions that are produced by newly arriving cells from the circulation in vivo and/or removal of the dermal cells.

span.label: EVERY EXPERIMENT SHOWN USES ABDOMINAL SKIN ONLY, stated by the authors in their own discussion
span.quote: Of note, for all experiments shown in the manuscript we have used abdominal skin only.

span.label: Re-epithelialization in the model is slower than in vivo, which the paper attributes to missing culture factors and to the removal of dermal cells
span.quote: This was somewhat delayed compared to in vivo experiments41 and may be due to a deficiency of factors under culture conditions that are produced by newly arriving cells from the circulation in vivo and/or removal of the dermal cells.

span.label: The model produces a differentiation pattern NOT seen in normal skin - DSG1 and CDSN in lower epidermal layers, read as premature cornification
span.quote: Their formation was observed in lower epidermal layers in blister-induced wounds only and does not occur in normal skin, suggesting a potential premature cornification

span.label: No separation method is appropriate for all purposes, on the paper's own account - so the model is offered as one technique among several rather than as a replacement
span.quote: However, none of the methods is appropriate for all purposes and several research questions require another separation technique.

span.label: The literature is described as large and yet lacking a standardised ex vivo model that leaves the dermal compartment undisrupted
span.note: about this quote: the quote carries SMALL-CAPS RENDERED AS LOWERCASE: the paper's “Nonetheless” opens a sentence and is staged as “nonetheless”. Verbatim against the staged text and harmless to the reading, but it is why the sentence looks like a comma splice. Confidence 0.85 under Q-606.
span.quote: A large body of literature is available on wound healing in humans. nonetheless, a standardized ex vivo wound model without disruption of the dermal compartment has not been put forward with compelling justification.

span.label: the same suction applied to ex vivo thigh and arm skin, to show the method does not depend on the body site
span.note: eliminates: that the re-epithelialization result is a property of abdominal skin, which is what was available - the paper says thigh and arm skin gave the same result and does not show it · outcome: absent-declared-unreported · would have ruled out, had it been run: the objection that the model works only on abdominal skin
span.quote: We would like to emphasize that similar results were repeatedly obtained when suction was applied on ex vivo thigh and arm skin, showing that the method is reproducible irrespective of the body location which is important as abdominal skin is not always available.
